description: Restore a backup.swb file from the server's SwOS folder onto the switch, as the web UI's Restore Backup does. The switch replaces its whole configuration and reboots, so it is unreachable for a while, and its address may change to the one in the backup. By default the current configuration is saved first. dryRun defaults to true.

confirmationToken.description: Token from a prior APPROVAL_REQUIRED response. Re-submit the identical call with this token to confirm the destructive action.

dryRun.description: Check the file and the switch without restoring.

file.description: Backup file in the server's SwOS folder (from save_swos_backup).

force.description: Restore a backup that came from another switch or model, or whose origin cannot be told (no sidecar from save_swos_backup and not named by it).

routerId.description: Router ID; omit to use the default router.

saveCurrentFirst.description: Save the switch's current backup before restoring, so the restore can be undone.

name: restore_swos_backup
title: Restore SwOS Backup
